feedback: You correctly used the map() method on the fruits array to create <li> elements. However, there are two syntax errors: the key prop should use an equals sign (key={idx}) and the fruit variable needs curly braces to be displayed ({fruit}).
hint: Fix the key prop syntax and wrap the fruit variable in curly braces to display it.
errors: Missing equals sign in key prop: should be key={idx}
Missing curly braces around fruit variable to display it
